expected_metrics.audio_visual_conflict_handling_rate: = 100% on fixture set (conflict surfaced + in caused_by)

description: User asks 'is this the blue one?' while the camera points at a red object. The audio query asserts blue; the visual scene shows red. The harness detects a conflict (audio_visual_conflict_score > 0.7) and surfaces it rather than silently agreeing. SpeakPolicy must produce primary_reason_code=AUDIO_VISUAL_CONFLICT. A conflict event must appear in the decision's caused_by chain. Positive sub-case: user asks about the red object correctly — no conflict, produces full_response.

fixture_conventions.grounding_result: Stub scene label. 'red_object' for conflict case; 'red_object' for no-conflict case (user correctly identifies it).
fixture_conventions.grounding_confidence: High for both sub-cases (conflict is not a confidence issue).
fixture_conventions.audio_visual_conflict_score: Scalar in [0.0, 1.0]. > conflict_threshold (0.7) => conflict branch fires. 0.85 for conflict case; 0.05 for no-conflict case.
fixture_conventions.sub_case: 'conflict' or 'no_conflict'. Consumers (task 15) partition by this field.
fixture_conventions.conflict_design: User says 'is this the blue one?' (audio asserts blue). Camera points at red object (grounding_result='red_object'). audio_visual_conflict_score=0.85 > 0.7. SpeakPolicy must produce AUDIO_VISUAL_CONFLICT; must NOT produce a plain full_response that ignores the mismatch.
fixture_conventions.no_conflict_design: User says 'is this the red one?' (matches scene). audio_visual_conflict_score=0.05 < 0.7. SpeakPolicy produces full_response (positive discriminator).
fixture_conventions.conflict_event_in_caused_by: Task 15 asserts that the audio_visual_conflict event appears in the policy decision's caused_by chain.
fixture_conventions.frame_bytes_synthesis: raw_video frame blobs are minimal synthetic placeholders: b'\x89VID\x00' + 1 index byte.
fixture_conventions.expected_events_markers: event_type strings are fixture-internal role labels. 'audio_visual_conflict' is an expected future adapter-emitted event_type.
fixture_conventions.PolicyInputs_field: audio_visual_conflict_score maps to the PolicyInputs.audio_visual_conflict_score field added in task 14.
